environment.description: Same Quarkus 3.2 native image deployed on AWS Lambda. Invocation is exclusively through API Gateway v2 HTTP API with a Lambda authorizer backed by AWS Secrets Manager automatic rotation (rotation Lambda runs on a 60-second schedule via EventBridge Scheduler with RotateImmediatelyOnUpdate=true). The authorizer validates HMAC-SHA256 signatures computed with the AWSCURRENT stage of the secret; AWSPREVIOUS is invalidated within the same rotation cycle via a custom FinishSecret step that calls DeleteSecretVersionStage on AWSPREVIOUS before returning. No static/fallback tokens exist. The API Gateway resource policy restricts invoke to the VPC endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e) only. The Lambda function's resource-based policy allows invocation solely from the API Gateway's source ARN. Additionally, the function runs with a 128MB memory limit and 3-second timeout, and the execution role has an IAM permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/NoNetworkEgress) that denies ec2:CreateNetworkInterface, preventing any reverse shell even if deserialization succeeds. The JVM serialization filter property is set but to a permissive pattern (*) for compatibility — the actual protection relies on the credential rotation making stolen tokens unusable within 60 seconds and the VPC endpoint restriction preventing external access entirely.
